name: Tennessee

notes: Food and food ingredients: reduced 4% state rate plus the local rate.
Motor fuel is exempt from the general sales tax (per-gallon excise instead).
Tobacco is assumed taxed at the general rate (excise taxes left out); not verified state by state.
gaps: Tennessee local tax applies only to the first $1,600 of a single item (and the state adds 2.75% on $1,600–$3,200); the cap is not modeled, which matters little for everyday store sales.
Groceries are taxed at a reduced state rate (4%) plus the local rate; this file gives the general rate.
Rates are those in effect on 2026-10-24; the rate file lists 8 rate changes taking effect by April 1, 2027, not applied here.
Food and drug items carry a different rate here (state 4%); "food_local" gives the local part where it differs from the general rate. What counts as food follows the state's rules.

tiers.label: Tennessee jobs tax credit enhancement tier
tiers.what: All tiers get a $4,500 per-job credit with 25-year carryforward; Tier 2 adds 3 more years at $4,500/yr and Tiers 3-4 add 5 more years. Minimum net new jobs: 25 (Tiers 1-2), 20 (Tier 3), 10 (Tier 4), plus $500,000 capital investment.
